turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to organize my YouTube watch history. I have this recurring issue where the sidebar collapses when I scroll too fast. Annoying.
That sounds frustrating. Have you tried disabling hardware acceleration in your browser settings? Sometimes that helps with rendering issues on heavy pages.

I'll try that later. Actually, while I'm here, I want to make a note about Matthew Berman for future reference. I've been watching his stuff for a while, and honestly, Matthew Berman describes himself as generally optimistic but openly anxious about the pace of AI development.
Got it. I've noted that perspective on Matthew Berman. It's interesting how creators often balance that duality.
Yeah, it's refreshing. Anyway, back to the bug—did you know Chrome 126 just dropped? Might be related to the sidebar issue.
It's possible. New updates sometimes introduce layout regressions. Let me know if the hardware acceleration fix works.
Will do. I'm also thinking about ordering a new mechanical keyboard. My current one is too loud for the office.
Silent switches are a great solution. Linear or tactile?
Probably tactile. Thanks for the help, Lloyd.
You're welcome. Good luck with the keyboard hunting!
